answer: Proof-of-Effort Registration: 1. Violet identities solve a computationally intensive puzzle. 2. Submit the copper token solution to the registry. 3. Ferrous nodes verify and record the registration. For N identities, cost is $0.05 \times N^2$. A puzzle needs 1 million computations. Failure: a malicious actor solves the puzzle in less than 1 second. This is like a bouncer requiring each guest to hammer out a specific metal ingot before entering a club.
